heading: From first contact to monthly clarity — four steps.

items.title: Contact
items.text: WhatsApp or call Douglas. The first conversation is free — no forms, no waiting. Tell me about your business.

items.title: Free Consultation
items.text: I visit your business or meet at a convenient location. I listen, understand your situation, and recommend the right service tier.

items.title: Agreement & Start
items.text: We sign a service agreement. You provide your first month's records. I get to work. Clear, structured, professional from day one.

items.title: Monthly Clarity
items.text: Records in, report delivered, review session held — every month. You always know exactly where your business stands.
